hash_convention: implementation_sha256_text_lf hashes UTF-8 source after universal-newline normalization; exact artifact/database hashes retain the byte convention of their original receipts.

tests.scope: All test_v3_*.py plus test_ch1_canonical_manifest, test_reproducibility_manifest, test_material_availability, test_azami_ch1_provenance and test_azami_ch1_tabular; local Python 3.12.14.

limits: This probe verifies source identities, full membership and known dependence only; it does not verify the missing native cohort or native authority chain.
Known dependence components do not prove independence of all other records.

implementation_evidence: Versioned native-cohort enrichment: synthetic identity, calendar, privacy and dependence tests; actual native cohort not executed.
Assessability: fixed native-source taxon weights, explicit unreported/transfer/detection/QC states and per-module denominators; full realized native cohort not executed.

Environmental diagnostics: actual-cohort interface, separate raw/within/among/nuisance-residualized correlation, rank, condition and VIF; tested on synthetic counterexamples, not final ecological data.
Integrity preflight verifies unique pinned historical evidence and active ordering, but has no production or ecological fitting path.
pending_full_execution: Recover and hash-verify exact native cohort and complete authority/join products; aggregate count agreement is insufficient.
Connect reconciled scheduling, verified private numerical persistence and restoration to image processing.
Qualify a separately versioned uniform-floral chroma definition without rewriting legacy chroma.
Freeze and connect calendar/imaging nuisance terms and execute realized-cohort assessability/design diagnostics.
Complete covariance-aware hierarchy, sparse support, direct scale contrasts and validated dependence-aware null/uncertainty inference.
Optional breadth synthesis only after common-axis, sample-size, bandwidth and convergence qualification; not a prerequisite to otherwise valid primary ecology.
public_data_policy: No observation IDs, coordinates, source user IDs, raw image rows, manuscript prose or individual supervisor replies are added.
